name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold exploration and development company focused on its flagship Diablillos high-sulphidation silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project recently received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) and is advancing toward a definitive feasibility study. The company is in the advanced developer stage with multiple active drill programs ongoing.
